shared_elements: schematic human form (small stick-like figures in A; the statue itself in B)
incised curvilinear lines carved in shallow relief
justification: The only real overlap is generic: both surfaces bear schematic incised carvings including circular/ring motifs and a reduced, non-naturalistic treatment of the human form. Otherwise the depicted content is wholly different: A is a scattered scene of crewed boats with rows of stroke-figures, small animals and human figures distributed across an open field, while B is a single monumental anthropomorphic figure whose back carries an enclosed arrangement of curvilinear loops, rings and a belt-like band with no narrative scene at all.
